items.title: IOC Q4 results: Cons PAT surges 78% YoY to Rs 14,458 crore, revenue rises 7%
items.description: Indian Oil Corporation announced a significant 78% jump in net profit for the March quarter. Revenue also saw a healthy increase. The company's board recommended a final dividend for shareholders. Despite global uncertainties, IOC's profitability remained strong. Financial metrics like debt-to-equity ratio and profit margins showed improvement.
